ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels to 30% low-intensity black pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous central regions on both lobes. Black pigmentation is concentrated along the trailing edges, forming irregular bands with vertical linear streaks extending toward the center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel variations along the dark trailing edge boundary, characterized by numerous small peaks and valleys isolated against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curves define the outer superior edges of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, textured tan/white pixels indicating barnacle colonization on the far distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the white ventral surface of the right lobe, extending from the trailing edge toward the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle clusters present on the distal edges of both lobes.
